description: What the Ohio ODM exclusion/suspension data covers and how current it is: total rows (individuals plus organizations), how many are currently excluded/suspended vs. status-unknown, how many carry an NPI, and the oldest/newest exclusion effective date. Use to check the screening data is fresh enough to rely on before a compliance decision, and to see the one-line note on the status field's gaps. Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT how many exclusions have an effective date in that year or range, counted over the whole 2,100+ row list, not a page — answers "how many Ohio ODM exclusions took effect in 2025". The response names the date field counted (action_date / ODM's Action Date — never date_added, which answers a different question and gives a different number). Sourced from the Ohio ODM Provider Exclusion & Suspension List, keyless.

end_date.description: Inclusive range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Use with start_date for a custom date range instead of a calendar year.

start_date.description: Inclusive range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Use with end_date for a custom date range instead of a calendar year.

year.description: Count records whose date field falls in this calendar year (e.g. 2025), counted over the WHOLE list, not a page. Ignored if start_date/end_date are given.
